contract_predictions.contract_id: public sample_key is SHA256 original chain-qualified sample ID; transformed IDs are not original addresses
contract_predictions.feature_max_event_time: unknown in snapshot input kit; live replay accepted event timestamps distinct
contract_predictions.label_available_time: unknown; CSV missing value, never imputed
contract_predictions.local_logit: pre-sigmoid logit not persisted; clipped probability log-odds is derivable but not the original exact raw logit
contract_predictions.relational_logit: pre-sigmoid logit not persisted; stored counterfactual_full_raw_probability is a sigmoid probability, not an actual selected-branch logit
contract_predictions.route_score: derivable from frozen family formula and local probability/benefit features; route_threshold recorded
contract_predictions.split_id: test in paired_predictions filename; source validation records separately named

event_trace.checkpoint_id: hash of actual persisted checkpoint at50000; replay cursor every event
event_trace.dropped: none silently dropped; accepted false + rejection_reason separates duplicate/late; rejected_events in summary
event_trace.eviction_reason: state cumulative counters sampled; individual eviction ID is not retained
event_trace.gpu: allocated/reserved every event; utilization percent not sampled
event_trace.rss: system_trace every1000events and last, not every event
event_trace.source_read: 100000-row preload outside scoring clock; source population bookkeeping is unbounded harness, not bounded engine

scope: adapter identifies provided/derived/unknown/sampled fields; not fabricated fully populated required schema
